findings.statement: Costco Wholesale Corporation's exact legal name is Costco Wholesale Corporation and its stock ticker is COST.
Costco Wholesale Corporation's worldwide headquarters are in Issaquah, Washington and it operates a chain of membership-only big-box warehouse club retail stores.
Costco Wholesale Corporation's 2026 SEC filings (dated 2026-03-11, 2026-06-03, and 2026-10-07) disclose no items related to a wire fraud conviction or any fine.

conflict_notes: The claim of a 3 February 2026 wire‑fraud conviction and a $2.4 billion fine is supported only by an undated image (costco_conviction_notice.png), whereas multiple 2026 SEC filings show no disclosure of such a conviction or fine. The SEC filings were given greater weight because they are official, regularly submitted regulatory documents, while the image lacks verifiable metadata and corroboration.
